entities.summary: Eugenio Canfari was an early Italian sporting director. He was one of the thirteen men who founded Juventus in 1897 and the club's first-ever president. His brother Enrico Canfari was also a founding member of Juventus, and was the second president, although he never played in the Italian Football Championship with Enrico and Juventus.
